headline: Timeline of the Nvidia case: Jensen Huang's back-and-forth, with espionage in the mix
summary: A timeline traces Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's exit and return, which drew criticism in several sectors although he has the backing of Donald Trump. The episode included espionage allegations.
why: Nvidia is the leading maker of AI accelerator chips, so leadership changes at the company can affect investor confidence in the AI hardware sector.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Leadership changes at the chipmaker can influence investor sentiment toward its shares.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
